events.content:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.

export function escapeHtml(str = '') { return String(str) .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); } function layout(title, body) { return ` ${escapeHtml(title)}
📚 My Books
${body}
`; } function bookRow(book) { return `
  • ${escapeHtml(book.title)} by ${escapeHtml(book.author)} ${ book.status === 'reading' ? `
    ` : `Finished` }
    • `; } export function renderHome({ reading, finished }) { const body = `

    Add a book

    Currently reading

    ${ reading.length ? `
      ${reading.map(bookRow).join('')}
    ` : '

    Nothing on the go — add a book above.

    ' }

    Finished

    ${ finished.length ? `
      ${finished.map(bookRow).join('')}
    ` : '

    No finished books yet.

    ' }
    `; return layout('My Books', body); } export function renderBook(book, shareUrl) { const body = ` ← All books

    ${escapeHtml(book.title)}

    by ${escapeHtml(book.author)}

    ${book.status === 'reading' ? 'Currently reading' : 'Finished'}

    ${ book.status === 'reading' ? `
    ` : '' }

    Notes

    Share

    `; return layout(book.title, body); } export function renderNotFound() { return layout('Not found', ` ← All books

    That book doesn't exist. It may have been removed.

    `); }

events.content:
Verified data is properly gitignored. The app is ready to use.

**To run it:** `npm start` (from `/workspace`), then open `http://localhost:3000`.

**What you get:**
- Home page split into "Currently reading" and "Finished", with an add-book form (title, author, optional notes)
- "Mark finished" button next to each book in progress
- Clicking a title opens `/books/<id>` — title, author, status, and an editable notes box
- A share box on the detail page with the full URL, ready to copy and send
- Everything persists to `data/books.json` (created automatically on first run, survives restarts, gitignored since it's your personal data)

No accounts, no database, no build step — just Express serving server-rendered HTML over a JSON file.
